# form.addBitmapField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.2.11</span></div>

Add a bitmap field to the current form.

```lua
form.addBitmapField(line, rect, path, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `path` | string | yes | the bitmaps directory |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current bitmap name |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on bitmap change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addBitmapField(line, nil, "/bitmaps/models", function() return bitmap end, function(newValue) bitmap = newValue end)
```

- [tool-form](../../examples/official/tool-form.md)
